RAM Ride

Jacksonville, FL · Riverside · Social

Beginner friendly

RAM Ride is a social group ride in Jacksonville, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Under the Fuller Warren Bridge, Riverside. Pace: easy.

About the RAM Ride group ride

Easy Saturday morning ride that starts under the Fuller Warren Bridge in Riverside, near the Riverside Arts Market. Listed by ZenCog as one of the city's regular community rides.
